::: {.row .g-3 .my-3}
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Why Newark (EWR) Records Higher Delays</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">EWR experiences intersection constraints between parallel runway operations and high corporate hub banking from United Airlines. When convective weather halts Mid-Atlantic arrival gates, Newark ground hold durations escalate rapidly.</p>
</div>
:::
::: {.col-md-6}
<div class="kpi-card h-100">
  <div class="kpi-label">Why LaGuardia (LGA) Leads in Punctuality</div>
  <p class="small text-secondary mb-0">LGA operates under federal perimeter slot controls that cap the total operations per hour, mitigating systemic over-scheduling and preserving high on-time reliability (81.1%).</p>
</div>
:::
:::
